title: Asynchronous Report Generation API
objective: Generate large reports without holding a request open for the full job.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Submit a job and return 202 Accepted
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate submit a job and return 202 accepted in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Poll operation status and retrieve the result
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate poll operation status and retrieve the result in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Cancellation, bounded retries, and expiry cleanup
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate cancellation, bounded retries, and expiry cleanup in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Workflow diagram, failure recovery, and monitoring
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate workflow diagram, failure recovery, and monitoring in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

required_features: Submit a job and return 202 Accepted
Poll operation status and retrieve the result
Cancellation, bounded retries, and expiry cleanup
Workflow diagram, failure recovery, and monitoring
stretch_features: Add contract validation to CI and detect a breaking change.
Add structured request IDs and useful metrics without logging secrets.
Document a recovery or migration trade-off with alternatives.
tests: Test success, missing-resource, validation, and authorization outcomes.
Test duplicates and concurrent updates where the domain has non-idempotent side effects.
Run tests against a disposable database with deterministic fixtures.
Review public responses and logs for secret or personal-data exposure.
review_method: Automated tests and static contract checks plus human review against the rubric; no arbitrary learner code executes inside CodeLeaf’s production API.
status_note: Unreviewed project draft; validate scope, starter files, rubric and implementation assumptions before publication.
